title: Western Arctic caribou
text: The Western Arctic caribou herd migrates across northern Alaska and passes through both Kobuk Valley and Gates of the Arctic. Its river crossings in autumn are a major event at Kobuk.
when: Move north in spring to calve and south again before winter; river crossings at Kobuk peak in autumn.
matters: Caribou follow food across a huge area. Wolves, bears and people along the route depend on their passing.
